faq.q: What services does Aten & Garofalo Dentistry offer?
faq.a: We provide cleaning and prevention, cosmetic procedures like whitening and veneers, restorative work including crowns and implants, emergency dental care, and sleep apnea treatment with custom snore guards.

faq.q: How do I schedule an appointment?
faq.a: Click 'Request an appointment' above or call +1-704-540-4252. We respond to requests even after hours and on weekends.
Monday–Wednesday 8 AM–5 PM, Thursday 7 AM–2 PM, and Friday by appointment.
